headline: Midterm elections today and Iran peace hopes (oil -7% yesterday) set the tone ahead of Friday's jobs report, with rate-hike odds still elevated.
rates: 10-year yield eased to about 4.89% and the 30-year to about 5.27% as lower oil softened the inflation outlook, while the 2-year held near 4.58%.
fed: CME FedWatch priced roughly a 72% chance of a December hike as of Monday; the next FOMC decision is Dec 9 and the October minutes come Nov 18.
oil: WTI settled at $96.46 (-7.4%) and Brent at $104.77 (-7.6%), the biggest daily drop since July 27, on hopes for a US-Iran deal via Qatari mediators.
geo: US-Iran talks are active (Iran offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under conditions), and US midterm voting is today with polls favoring Democrats.
